notes.title: Update v0.15.0
notes.content:
v0.15.0

● Fixed bug with Psycho Kill Hanging Achievement wasn't counting

● Added more Steam Achievements including level 3 new achievements

● Now if you collect all Syringe on the map you will complete the achievement

● Added Leaderboard and score collecting which happen to count at the end of every chapter or level
then is sent to Steam

● We had a plan of creating 3 or 4 chapters of the current season but for various changes and story-wise
we decided that we will end this season at chapter 3 then will work on survival mode to complete it asap for more fun and joy
we might as well in future provide :
1) HDRP version of GAME
2) Work on the Multiplayer system of the game with various game types like BattleRoyal, DeathMatch, and Skip Place.
The multiple versions might be very different than this version of the game for various reasons but we have that in mind.

● New Vision Filters and Shaders

● Improved other game content overall

● Improved Shooting is much smoother now

● Added A new feature to zombie Vision: The time will slow down while using it.

● Added some edits to the last added filters

● Added a new weapon swap interface at the main screen rather than inside the inventory panel

● Added Shooting with releasing mouse button easier to handle way

● Swap weapons using Mouse Wheel as well

● Added GamePad/Xbox/PS4 support, although we didn't create a virtual mouse yet please be patient and wait for the next updates for more work on this

● Added Head Explode when dying with a headshot

● Fixed some effects and filters

● Improved Gore and blood all over the place

● Fixed a lot of gameplay and content which will make the game much more user friendly and easier to handle

>> Things can expect in future

- Survival Mode

- Adding new Splash Scene

- Fixing any bug found in v0.15.0

● Added weapon swap using the mouse wheel

● Getting Damaged Reduce Move Speed by -15% rather than -30% before

● Adding option to disable starting tips

● Fixed bug with spam load time at level win

● Fixed some other bugs in the System overall

>> Things can expect in future

- Get tasks needed to clear level (inventory panel)

notes.title: New Upcoming two updates
notes.content:
- We are going to release two updates first one is v0.9.1 and second one is v0.10.0

- The updates will fix a lot of game logics and improving the graphic control overall improving game optimization and solving a lot of game crashing issue

- We are also going to include new vision features which will help you with paint like traces of where to go and what to do next the vision will apply with the hold of F1 and you wont be able to move during vision an interesting thing about vision is that it will help you see enemy behind objects the vision is one of the abilities our character will acquire during his journey

- Next and future updates will also include new items of them items which will boost your health, stamina and recovery with much more to see in that

- We are going to continue fixing and improving this game so please hit our community page and share your experience with the demo helping us to land a better release by 1 April and afterward 

- Thanks all for the support and taking time to play our game we wish that we provide you with the best experience possible so please don't hesitate to mention your opinion and review on the content but please be specific so you can help us identify the problem and improve the game

<3 <3 <3 <3 Thanks all
